steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They will try to kill you any way they can.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The Suspect R you're after is hiding out at the SALVA Hospital on the west of the square—that's a well-known Sinner force.
Hehe... I need to look into it then...
You try to move, but you can't find any strength and your body only feels numb. Your mind is going manic by horror.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What are you going to do to me?
Where are my companions? What did you do to them?

steps.content: She shoots you a glance before turning her gaze away and staring at the ceiling quietly.

The strong sense of threat from earlier has now disappeared. If it isn't for the familiar and fresh bullet holes in her body, you'd even have mistaken her as someone completely different from the killer you met this morning.
Someone pulls open the curtain and enters in. You close your eyes immediately.
...Luckily, nothing happened.
A hand gently strokes your forehead. You open your eyes slightly and see a woman in SALVA nurse uniform looking at you with concern.

...So much sweat. You must be very anxious.
You're safe now.
She wipes away the sweat from your forehead with a warm, wet towel, then gently comforts you like comforting a baby.

steps.speaker: SALVA Nurse
steps.content: Anne, Dr. Iron needs this person.
Shh! I'll be right there.
The nurse named <color=#fb9259>Anne</color> turned around, then she changed the bandages and medicine on the girl in the next bed gently and crisply while whispering softly.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Does it still hurt? Good... The morphine has taken effect and the doctor is back soon. She will come to see you later. Don't worry.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Stop thinking about those horrible things. If you feel anxious, just come to me anytime, okay?

The young girl remains quiet. Instead of getting upset, Anne simply gently pulls up the blanket to cover her arms, then returns to your bedside and reaches out to examine the hanging pale yellow infusion bag.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content:
Well, the density is a bit high... No wonder you can't relax.
Iron is often so impatient, which won't be easy on the patients.
She gently holds the infusion bag in her hand. Your heart suddenly skips a beat as you watch the yellow liquid in the infusion bag gradually become clear.
The gentle nurse before you is a Sinner from SALVA—your enemy.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Come. Let's take him to Iron.
steps.female_content: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Come. Let's take her to Iron.

steps.speaker: SALVA Nurse
steps.content: Sure! Let me help you push the bed.
You feel a shake, then you feel yourself being pushed away, along with the hospital bed. The ceiling recedes at a fast pace and a door quickly approaches—Where are they taking you?

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Anne, quick. The medical director is getting impatient. Those two Sinners are so difficult to handle.
*** Let me go!!
A voice sounds from behind the door—it's Hella. She sounds angry. What happened?
Whether you are valuable enough to be a hostage or not, this Sinner next to you will definitely be your enemy. If it is a Sinner, your shackles will...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content:
Please don't do that, Mr. ${PlayerName}.
Or you will upset her.
steps.female_content:
Please don't do that, Ms. ${PlayerName}.
Or you will upset her.

steps.content: Bang—! The door slams open. A silver scalpel flies out and plunges into your hospital bed, right next to your hand, which you lifted to use the shackles on Anne.
What do you want to do to my head nurse?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: You scared our patient, Iron. Our patient only just woke up and hasn't done anything.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But you never push a sleeping patient out of the room. You knew our patient was only pretending to be asleep, Anne.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Sigh... I tried to walk as quietly as I could.

There is no point in pretending now. You open your eyes. A white-robed doctor with black hair and silver pupils stands in front of a group of SALVA doctors. Your two Sinners are sitting fixedly in the ward chairs.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}! She's a Sinner, the boss of SALVA, the hardcore doctor—Iron.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, this guy did something to us. I can't feel my body. I can't move!!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Her ability is to manipulate nerves and she's good at using drugs. Rating A, but very difficult to deal with.
Iron waves her hand, then a silver flash occurs, and the two Sinners are released from their chairs and pushed toward you.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I'm Iron, the head doctor of SALVA, performing my duties in this dump.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I heard you defeated my colleagues and even tried to attack my head nurse...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Come on, the new Chief of Minos. Let's see what you're capable of.
